sloka: सर्वभूतेषु चावज्ञा यथा पापकृतस्तथा ।कथम् रथैर्विभुर्गत्वा गजाश्वैएश्च मुहूर्महुः ॥२-१२-९७॥
transliteration: sarvabhūteṣu cāvajñā yathā pāpakṛtastathā ।katham rathairvibhurgatvā gajāśvaieśca muhūrmahuḥ ॥2-12-97॥

translations.english: How will my son, Rama, who used to ride on chariots, elephants and horses roam the wilderness barefoot?
